headline: China Moves to Simplify Foreign Exchange Settlements for Cross-Border Trade
summary: China's State Administration of Foreign Exchange released draft proposals detailing nine measures to streamline current-account FX transactions and reduce cross-border payment costs.
why: Foreign exchange regulations in China govern cross-border capital management, trade clearing costs, and foreign direct investment flexibility.

impacts.name: China
impacts.why: Simplifying foreign exchange settlements lowers compliance burdens for international businesses trading with China.
